summary: Twelve headlines, only three NVDA-specific, and they disagree. The dominant fact is a scheduled catalyst: NVDA reports Q2 FY2027 earnings on 2026-08-26, two sessions out, consensus ~$92B revenue and ~95-97% YoY growth. One piece makes the valuation case (forward P/E 24x vs S&P 21.4x) and frames this as the last cheap entry. Another directly counters it: historically NVDA has often FALLEN after beating, with a shrinking margin of outperformance. A third argues TSMC, not NVDA, is the structural winner as hyperscalers move to custom silicon. The remainder is sector-adjacent (Broadcom/Marvell/Alphabet rotation, Vistra power demand) or generic market commentary, including one explicitly defensive 'if a bear market is coming' piece advising reduced tech exposure. Net: no directional consensus in the news, elevated event risk into 08-26, and the next two sessions dominated by positioning ahead of the print rather than by anything in today's tape.
